summary.text: Brad Battin is the Liberal member for Berwick, which he has held since 2022 after representing Gembrook from 2010 until that seat was abolished. He was Leader of the Liberal Party and Leader of the Opposition from December 2024 until a party-room spill in November 2025. He has since been shadow minister for police and corrections, and is standing again in Berwick in 2026.

occupation.text: Police officer, then owner of a bakery franchise

summary.text: Ethelyn King is the Libertarian candidate for Berwick at the 2026 Victorian election. She works in corporate learning and development and was previously a recruiter. She has stood several times for the party, which was formerly called the Liberal Democrats: in Chisholm at the 2022 federal election, second on its South-Eastern Metropolitan upper-house ticket in 2022, and in the 2023 Mulgrave by-election. She was not listed on the Libertarians' 2026 candidates page as at early November 2026.

summary.text: Michael Piastrino is One Nation's candidate for Berwick at the 2026 Victorian election. At the 2022 state election he stood as the Liberal candidate in Mulgrave against then premier Daniel Andrews. The ABC says he grew up in Endeavour Hills, has owned a hair salon in Albert Park since 2007, has three times been named Victorian Hairdresser of the Year, and has promoted boxing events. One Nation's candidate page refused automated access.

sources.title: Berwick: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Nalinda Amarasiri Gunawardana is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Berwick at the 2026 Victorian election. A civil engineer and Engineers Australia member, he lives in Clyde North and was once a coordinator for Amnesty International's Western Australian branch. He says he has been a community organiser for more than 25 years, 12 of them in Australia, campaigning on racism, climate change and Palestine.

summary.text: Rana Khan is Labor's candidate for Berwick, the seat of former Liberal leader Brad Battin, at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC says he came to Australia from Pakistan in 2001, spent more than 13 years as a police officer, and completed a degree in applied management in 2023. Labor's candidate page gives no further biography.

summary.text: Scott Dowling is the Australian Citizens Party candidate for Berwick at the 2026 Victorian state election. He was elected as an independent for Akoonah Ward on the City of Casey in October 2024, the first election after the council had been run by administrators since 2020. According to the council, he runs a real estate business in Berwick, and before that worked mostly for big companies in sales jobs up to national general manager.

summary.text: Vincenzo De Paolis is the Family First candidate for Berwick at the 2026 Victorian election. The ABC reports that he migrated from Italy in 2014, works in aged care and community services, and is president of Uniti in Australia, an Italian association. His Family First page carried no biography as at early November 2026.
